title: Game crashes when changing scenes while using a SubViewport with main Viewport's 2D world in it and a sound playing
body:
### Tested versions

v4.3.stable.official [77dcf97d8]

### System information

Godot v4.3.stable - Windows 11 (24H2, 26100.2605) - GLES3 (Compatibility) - NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090 (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.6636) - 13th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i9-13900K (32 Threads)

### Issue description

I'm sorry if I'm not reporting this correctly, this is my first time addressing such a complex issue and took a while to figure out the details.

The game crashes when switching scenes while using a `SubViewport` containing the main `Viewport`'s `World2D` and a sound playing.

However, the crash does not occur if all audio nodes are removed from the scene that includes the `SubViewport`.

This issue seems to be caused by the engine not properly removing the `SubViewport` when switching scenes.

### Crash cause
![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/e1b24964-8d18-4d09-9471-91b64d4f2c18)

### Call stack
![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/81529f7e-3ee2-40a0-aec4-e420c01e36db)

### Viewports related operations
![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/3571ca5f-93a7-44bf-a4d5-66e6fa29c525)

P. S. The `SubViewport` in question isn't even an audio listener, so this is confusing. (Edit) Oooh... I guess it is, since it has main `Viewport`'s world? Is this how it works?

### Steps to reproduce

1. Set up a scene with a `SubViewport` containing the main `Viewport`'s `World2D`.
2. Include audio node playing in this scene.
3. Switch scenes using either `get_tree().change_scene_to_file()` or `get_tree().change_scene_to_packed()`
_(e.g., transitioning between a main menu and a gameplay scene)_
4. Repeat the scene transitions back and forth.
The game crashes randomly after one or more scene switches.

### Example

Set this in a scene you're switching to.
```gdscript
func _ready() -> void:
  $SubViewport.world_2d = get_tree().current_scene.get_viewport().world_2d
```
Then switch scenes with `get_tree().change_scene_to_file()` or `get_tree().change_scene_to_packed()` back and forth
_(e.g. from main menu to gameplay scene and back)_ and the game randomly crashes at some point _(after the first or a few scenes switches)_

Manually introducing a custom removal mechanism for the `SubViewport` appears to resolve the crash.
```gdscript
func _ready() -> void:
  tree_exiting.connect(func(): $SubViewport.world_2d = null)
  $SubViewport.world_2d = get_tree().current_scene.get_viewport().world_2d
```

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[subviewport-crash.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/18223215/subviewport-crash.zip)
